input: Find sports (team sports, gymnastics, martial arts, swimming, tennis, golf and others) summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Weaverville, Woodfin, Leicester, Candler, Barnardsville, Marshall, Mars Hill and Hot Springs, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
